scenario: the first practical exchange about appointments & schedules
english_title: Recognising and Responding to the First Practical Exchange About Appointments and Schedules
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: appointments & schedules — the first practical exchange about appointments & schedules
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to the first practical exchange about appointments & schedules; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Thomas if he has an appointment available today.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi anh Thomas hôm nay có lịch hẹn trống không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Thomas, do you have an appointment available today?
turns.vietnamese: Thomas này, hôm nay anh có lịch hẹn trống không?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Three o'clock is perfect, thank you.
turns.vietnamese: Ba giờ tốt quá, cảm ơn anh.
